title: Stripe object ID
summary: Stripe uses prefixed IDs for all objects: a 2-4 letter prefix (e.g. 'cus_', 'ch_', 'pi_', 'in_', 'sub_', 'pm_') followed by 24-30 alphanumeric characters. The prefix identifies the object type; the rest is a random identifier.

notes: Prefix identifies the object type: 'cus_' (customer), 'ch_' (charge), 'pi_' (payment intent), 'in_' (invoice), 'sub_' (subscription), 'pm_' (payment method), 'acct_' (account), 'evt_' (event), etc.
The remaining characters are a random alphanumeric string (base-62-ish, no underscores).
IDs are case-sensitive and unique within a Stripe account.
Test mode and live mode IDs have the same format but different values.
